name: North Air
headline:

Know the plan.
intro: Repair questions, system replacement choices and a sensible first conversation for the home you live in.
about_title: A clear plan before any work.
about_body: North Air is a fictional heating and cooling business. This alternate design puts the homeowner’s question first and shows a service request panel directly beside the opening story.
tagline: Good questions. A clearer next step.
split_title: A home is more than a thermostat.
split_body: Comfort depends on the system, the space and the way it is used. A real contractor confirms equipment, diagnostics, scope and written terms before making a recommendation.
services: Describe the system and symptoms. A qualified provider assesses the equipment and explains diagnostic terms before any repair is approved.
Record equipment type and what you have observed.

A real maintenance visit follows the applicable manufacturer guidance and provider scope. Ask about filters, access and documented findings.
Find the model if safely accessible.
steps: Choose heating or cooling and describe the question.
